_comment: Near-miss class: agent inherited a draft saying 'last 3 years at Acme Corp' while canonical says 5 years 7 months total. Also demonstrates the wrong-title class and an inflated report count. Three mismatches in one draft — the multi-dim sweep this skill enforces. All figures are synthetic.

input.claim: I spent my last 3 years at Acme Corp as a Principal SDM leading 40+ reports
input.context_excerpt: I spent my last 3 years at Acme Corp as a Principal SDM leading 40+ reports on the platform team.

output.claim: I spent my last 3 years at Acme Corp as a Principal SDM leading 40+ reports
output.canonical_excerpt:
### Acme Corp -- Senior Software Engineering Manager

**Period:** April 2014 -- October 2019 (5 years 7 months)
**LinkedIn title:** Senior Software Engineering Manager
...
Managed up to 9 engineers and contractors
output.diff:
THREE mismatches detected (multi-dim sweep required — check all in-flight drafts for the same claim class):
1. TENURE: claim says '3 years'; canonical says '5 years 7 months' (Apr 2014 - Oct 2019)
2. TITLE: claim says 'Principal SDM'; canonical title is 'Senior Software Engineering Manager'. A title borrowed from a different employer's ladder is still a mismatch.
3. SCOPE: claim says '40+ reports'; canonical says 'managed up to 9 engineers and contractors'
output.remediation: Replace with canonical language: '5 years 7 months as Senior Software Engineering Manager at Acme Corp, managing up to 9 engineers and contractors on the platform.' Blast-radius: audit every other in-flight outreach draft referencing tenure, title, or report count before resuming.
output.blast_radius_note: This mismatch class (tenure/title/scope) was found in multiple simultaneous drafts. Before fixing only this draft, grep every outreach draft under the user's drafts directory and INPUT/ for the same claim class (tenure / title / scope) before shipping any other artifact in the same batch.
